title: Finance
description: The church's cash book: income, expenses and balances.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: How income and expenses are classified.

hints.income: Income categories (tithes, offerings…). System ones can't be deleted: rename or deactivate them.
hints.expense: Expense categories (rent, utilities…). A category in use can't be deleted: deactivate it.

categories.name: Name
categories.systemNameHint: Leave it empty to use the default name.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Cash, bank accounts and wallets. Each account has its own currency.
accounts.deleteBody: Only an account without movements can be deleted. If it has history, deactivate it.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.namePlaceholder: For example: General cash, Main bank
accounts.currencyHint: The account's amounts are recorded in this currency (no conversion).
accounts.currencyLockedHint: With movements recorded, the currency can't be changed.
accounts.openingHint: What the account held when you started using Shaddai. Movements before that date are not allowed.

movements.title: Movements
movements.description: Everything that came in and went out of the accounts.

movement.contributorHint: For named tithes and offerings (shows in the yearly statement).

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts
transfer.noTargets: There is no other account in the same currency.

void.title: Void movement
void.body: The movement isn't deleted: it's voided with the reason and stops counting in the balance. For a transfer, both parts are voided.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.limits: Photos or PDF, up to 10 MB and 5 per movement.

pending.title: Pending offerings
pending.description: Offerings entered by leaders in their cell reports. Confirm what was received or reject it with a reason.
pending.difference: Difference from the reported amount: {{amount}}. It is recorded.
pending.noAccounts: There are no active accounts in {{currency}}.
pending.rejectBody: The leader will see it was rejected. If they fix the amount in the report, it comes back to this list.
pending.pendingHint: It is not in any account yet: confirm it from Pending offerings.

counts.title: Offering counts
counts.description: The offering of each service, counted by two people. Confirming it records the income.
counts.countersHint: Two different people count and sign off.
counts.billsHint: Loose cash: enter how many of each bill.
counts.othersHint: Transfers, card, or a cash total without detail.
counts.envelopesHint: Tithes or offerings in envelopes: recorded under the person's name.
counts.lockedLines: This count has named envelopes and you can't see them: you can confirm it but not change its lines.
counts.incomplete_one: {{count}} incomplete line will not be saved.
counts.incomplete_other: {{count}} incomplete lines will not be saved.
counts.confirmBody: {{amount}} will be recorded in {{account}}, counted by {{counter1}} and {{counter2}}. It cannot be edited afterwards, only voided.
counts.confirmed: Count confirmed: the income is in the account
counts.deleteBody: What was entered is lost. Confirmed counts are not deleted: they are voided.
counts.voidBody: All the income it generated is voided. The count keeps the reason; enter it again if needed.

periods.title: Monthly closes
periods.description: Closing a month saves the balances, and nothing dated in that month can be entered or changed afterwards.
periods.empty: There are no accounts yet: nothing to close.
periods.closeBody: Each account's balance is saved. Afterwards nothing dated in this month can be entered, edited or voided unless someone with permission reopens it.
periods.unresolved: {{pending}} pending offerings and {{drafts}} draft counts are dated in this month. If you close it, they must be resolved with a date in an open month.
periods.notesHint: For example: reconciled with the bank statement
periods.readyHint: The month has ended and the previous ones are closed: review the balances and close it.
periods.notEndedHint: The month has not ended yet. Balances update with every transaction.
periods.previousOpenHint: The previous months must be closed first.
periods.noAccounts: No accounts were open in this month.
periods.reopenBody: Transactions of the month can be entered and changed again, and the saved balances are discarded until it is closed again. Who reopened it and why is recorded.
periods.lockedMovement: This transaction's month is closed: it cannot be edited or voided.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Income statement, balances, monthly trend and contributions. Download them as PDF or Excel.
reports.contributionsHint: Only named contributions (tithes and offerings recorded to a person). Downloads are logged.
